constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (actor_user_id) REFERENCES iam.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (vendor_id) REFERENCES catalog.vendors(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
CHECK (parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> id)
FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES catalog.categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (source_path IS NULL OR btrim(source_path) <> ''::text AND ("left"(source_path, 1) <> ALL (ARRAY['/'::text, '\'::text])) AND source_path !~ '^[A-Za-z]:'::text)
FOREIGN KEY (image_id) REFERENCES catalog.product_images(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CHECK (status <> 'active'::text OR price IS NOT NULL AND currency IS NOT NULL AND availability <> 'unknown'::text)
FOREIGN KEY (variant_id) REFERENCES catalog.product_variants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES catalog.products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES catalog.products(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (variant_id, product_id) REFERENCES catalog.product_variants(id, product_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES catalog.products(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (status <> 'published'::text OR published_at IS NOT NULL)
FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES catalog.categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (created_by_user_id) REFERENCES iam.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (updated_by_user_id) REFERENCES iam.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (vendor_id) REFERENCES catalog.vendors(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (created_by_user_id) REFERENCES iam.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES iam.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (vendor_id) REFERENCES catalog.vendors(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (status <> 'processed'::text OR processed_at IS NOT NULL)
CHECK (on_hand_quantity IS NULL OR reserved_quantity <= on_hand_quantity)
FOREIGN KEY (listing_id) REFERENCES catalog.listings(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
